provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2025 WNBA semifinals and Finals as played: Las Vegas beat Indiana 3-2 and Phoenix beat Minnesota 3-1 in the semifinals (21-30 September), and Las Vegas swept Phoenix in the Finals (3-10 October). The semifinals are one event, game N holding both series' Game N, so Game 5 is Las Vegas and Indiana's alone; the Finals are one event of four games. The 2026 Finals were not over when this was gathered. The field is every player in the round's ESPN box scores, injured players included, with ESPN's position (G, F or C) and birth country (Aliyah Boston's US Virgin Islands as VI; Natasha Howard's and Anastasiia Olairi Kosu's, which ESPN leaves out, from Wikipedia); ranking is the player's 2025 regular-season Triple Threat total (points + rebounds + assists) with her playoff team, from Basketball-Reference's team totals (Olairi Kosu, who played no regular-season game for Minnesota, has none and ranks with the zeros); ties go by name. Each game's box score (points, rebounds, assists) is from ESPN, cross-checked player by player against Basketball-Reference, which agree on every line (Basketball-Reference names Olairi Kosu 'Anastasiia Kosu'). A player who did not play a game has no line; one who played and scored no point, rebound or assist has an empty line.
